plugin.name: depthdeck
plugin._long: Arranges windows into a depth deck: the focused window sits in front at full scale, the ones behind shrink and dim by focus depth.

option.name: enabled
option._long: Master switch. When disabled, every transformed window is unwound back to full scale and opacity.

option.name: layer_1_scale
option._long: Scale of the first card behind the focused one.

option.name: layer_1_opacity
option._long: Opacity of the first card behind the focused one.

option.name: layer_2_scale
option._long: Scale of the second card behind the focused one.

option.name: layer_2_opacity
option._long: Opacity of the second card behind the focused one.

option.name: max_layers
option._long: Number of depth levels over which the falloff interpolates down to the floor (scale 0.22 / opacity 0.05).

option.name: scatter
option._long: Offset the cards behind the front so each keeps a visible peek strip. Visual only — windows are never moved.

option.name: card_edge_scatter
option._long: Place back cards near a random workarea edge instead of at a random angle around the focused card.

option.name: card_scatter_reshuffle
option._long: Give back cards fresh positions whenever a card joins or leaves the deck.

option.name: card_peek_min
option._long: Smallest visible strip (px) a back card must keep outside the front card.

option.name: card_peek_max
option._long: Upper bound (px) for the radius used by the around-focused scatter mode.

option.name: animation_ms
option._long: Milliseconds used to interpolate scale, opacity and scatter changes. 0 switches animation off (values snap instantly).

option.name: maximized_front_scale
option._short: Scale of a maximised front card
option._long: When the focused window covers the workarea and other cards are in the deck, the front is rendered at this scale so the back cards peek out around it (depth perspective). 1.00 keeps the front full size, which hides every back card.
